messages:
opsbot: Paging: high tail latency and 5xx spike detected in dedicated pool 'echelon-prod-pool' (tenant=echelon-enterprise). Trigger: latency_p99 > 1200ms, error_rate > 3% (past 5m). Escalation target: #incidents -> @jamie-oncall
jamie-oncall: on it, joining bridge now. grabbing logs and checking autoscale events.
jamie-oncall: created bridge -> https://meet.redwood/bridge/5367001234 (opsbridge). inviteing @leo-sre @reena-eng @athena-eng
leo-sre: jumping in. first glance: sustained GPU OOM + redis KV cache errors for that tenant. attaching relevant log tail:```[2026-03-16T22:02:11Z] kv_cache: set failed: OOM
[2026-03-16T22:02:12Z] inference: request_id=af3c error=kv_cache_miss
[2026-03-16T22:02:12Z] redis: ERR maxmemory reached
[2026-03-16T22:02:13Z] runtime: aten::conv2d failed: out of memory```
reena-eng: looks like a tenant surge (bulk batch jobs) triggered cache thrash => eviction/paged IO => GPU memory pressure. we should isolate tenant and scale pool.
athena-eng: recommend cordon + scale steps: 1) cordon nodes serving tenant-echelon 2) spin up temporary burst nodes in dedicated pool (n2-highmem) 3) failover traffic to hosted model variant (redwood/decoder-v2-quant) for < 95% of requests via routing policy.
jamie-oncall: running cordon now: `kubectl label node node-42 isolate=echelon-tenant` then `kubectl drain node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
leo-sre: cordon succeeded for node-42, draining. starting autoscale for echelon-prod-pool -> +3 GPUs. monitoring.
sasha-ae: heads-up from AE: Echelon (customer) on premium contract, they're likely to page. What's immediate customer impact (errors, timeouts)?
maya-cs: eagle-eye: customer dashboard shows 27% request errors for a subset of routes (embedding + chat). backlog in their queues. they'll likely see degraded throughput; some requests retried. prepping comms.
jamie-oncall: mitigation: scaled +3 GPUs, isolated tenant traffic off noisy nodes, enabled fallback routing to hosted-quant for non-sensitive routes. observed p99 drop from 1.3s -> 420ms within 6 min, 5xx down to 0.8%.
leo-sre: added temporary rate-limit to echelon tenant batch endpoints to prevent repeated surge, set limit 50 rps for 10m window via rate-limiter config. snippet:```rate_limit:
  tenant: "echelon-enterprise"
  route: "/v1/batch/embeddings"
  threshold_rps: 50
  window_sec: 600```
sasha-ae: thanks. need an initial customer update ASAP. Maya, can you send a short note: what happened, current state, and next steps + ETA?
maya-cs: drafting now. proposed: "We've contained the issue. Traffic limited and tenant isolated, performance recovering. We are provisioning additional capacity and will follow up with RCA and any credits if SLA impacted." want to confirm numbers before send.
reena-eng: confirmed root cause hypothesis: sudden large internal batch job from customer's side plus suboptimal KV cache retention caused cascading evictions and GPU memory pressure. RCA pending deeper heap/profile.
athena-eng: we should capture heap/dump from affected runtime before we uncordon nodes. scheduling capture at 22:20Z.
jamie-oncall: customer's SLO: 99.9% availability for dedicated pool. current 5min window shows 99.5% — potential SLA miss. flagging for credits discussion.
sasha-ae: putting this on my tracker. please keep me posted with exact downtime window and % impacted, I'll prep exec note.
leo-sre: can we run quick query to get exact error-window? `SELECT count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE tenant='echelon-enterprise' AND status >=500 AND ts BETWEEN 2026-03-16T21:58:00Z AND 2026-03-16T22:12:00Z;` expect ~1200 errors.
jamie-oncall: query returning ~1187 errors. storing snapshot in /incidents/5367001234/echelon_error_snapshot.log
opsbot: Incident milestone: Mitigation applied (isolation + scale + rate-limit) at 2026-03-16T22:08:40Z. Notify: #customer-success, #sales for AE follow-up.
maya-cs: sending customer note now (short): "We're aware of elevated errors for your dedicated pool. We've isolated affected nodes, throttled batch traffic, and added temporary capacity. Performance is recovering; we'll follow up with an RCA and next steps within 48h." sending... :mailbox_with_mail:
sasha-ae: received, passing to customer leadership. they asked for exec-level summary and whether credits will be applied.
reena-eng: for RCA we need reproducer: enable debug logging for 2 hours, capture heap/profile, and collect KV cache metrics (hit/miss/evictions). I'll owner that.
athena-eng: follow-up actions: (1) tune KV cache eviction policy for tenant heavy tails, (2) add tenant-level surge protection that rejects heavy bulk jobs instead of thrashing cache, (3) improve autoscale cooldown to add capacity faster for dedicated pools.
leo-sre: creating follow-up ticket: INC-5367001234 with tasks + RCA owner + timeline.
jamie-oncall: handoff: I'm going offline in 15m; @leo-sre will be lead for mitigation -> handoff note posted in bridge.
leo-sre: acknowledged, taking ownership for next 24h. will coordinate RCA draft and exec summary.
sasha-ae: require estimated customer credit calc if SLA breached. preliminary calc: outage-equivalent = (0.4% short of 99.9 over billing window) -> ~2.5% monthly credit? will confirm.
maya-cs: post-incident comm plan: 1) initial note (sent), 2) RCA draft within 48h, 3) exec brief within 72h, 4) postmortem and remediation timeline in ticket.
opsbot: Bridge closed by jamie-oncall at 2026-03-16T22:26:00Z (mitigation stable).
jamie-oncall: thanks all. next steps: leo to own RCA and comms, reena to collect traces, athena to propose surge protections, sasha/maya to coordinate customer credits/exec note.
leo-sre: will post RCA skeleton by 2026-03-17T10:00Z and ping @sasha-ae for credit calc.
maya-cs: noted. will schedule customer follow-up meeting if they request.
sasha-ae: thanks team. closing handoff. :handshake:
